title: 第1章 跑路了第2章 狗都不当
slug: 本掌门负债成仙第158章陷阱
content_zh:
苍风大陆，宁梨州。
碧天如洗，白云似棉，一道彩光划过，在天空中拖出一道光影，许久才慢慢散去。
花乾脚踩一支化作脸盆大的桃花玉钗灵器，身后洒下彩光和桃花瓣幻影，一刻不停息地往门派飞。
她在外游历时，无意中听说，自己所在的守灵门在二十年前，从各处借了大笔债务，用来增强门下弟子的实力。
想要在三十年后九聚秘域大会上，一举夺得头筹，得到的好处不止能还清所有债务，还能提高门派在苍风大陆的地位。
筑基后已经出来游历了二十九年的花乾根本不知道此事，听到消息后，她就急匆匆地往回赶，也想要分一杯羹。
虽然此事已经过去二十年，但这点时光对修士来说，也就能闭个小关，门派弄到的大批物资根本就用不完。
花乾根本没想到，一向稳重老成只想慢慢提升实力的掌门师父，竟然能下这么大的决心，借如此多的债务。
看来大师兄八成是在自己离开的这些年里，已经进阶结丹中期了吧，才让掌门信心大增，敢放言要去争夺九聚秘域的好处。
“不知道除了大师兄，二三四五六七八等各位师兄，都分到了什么好东西。只要每位师兄师姐分我一件东西，我就是全门派最富有的崽了。”她美滋滋地想道。
花乾作为守灵门这个只有三十二位弟子的小派中最小的弟子，深受掌门的喜爱。
她平时也得到三十一位师兄师姐的关爱照顾，离开门派出去游历时，师兄师姐们纷纷解囊相助，把身上除了本命法宝之外的好东西都送给了她。
让她放心去游历，不用担心门派的事，几百年不回门派，待到结丹元婴之后再回来也可。
千万不要没事就回来，修士志向四方，整天想着回门派可不好。
要是行的话，找个名门大宗的俊杰天才，直接嫁过去当掌门或是长老夫人，尽力去追求自己的幸福，绝对不要挂念门派中的各位，大家只想她能够过得好。
花乾深受感动，这次回来也给师兄师姐们带了不少好东西。
有在三千里外那个小村镇上买的水果、烧饼馒头猫屎糖等小点心，还有香囊木珠子手串绸头花等物，都是门派中没有的东西。
虽然不值钱，但胜在是自己的一片心意，她觉得师兄姐们一定会万分感动，把门派分到的好东西转送给自己。
要是有个十来件法宝给自己就好了。
花乾咂咂嘴，灵力注入桃玉钗，飞得更快了，巴不得瞬间就回到门派。

八天后，[cáng]藏仙山，守灵门。
紧赶慢赶，花乾终于见到了熟悉的门派，心中一阵激动，径直往山门飞去。
突然，她远远地就看到山门处围了很多人，足有二三百名修士，大家集中在山门边的一片石壁前。
“咦？”花乾有些奇怪，如果她没记错的话，山门边的明明是座十几丈高的守山石，山壁上有创门祖师爷刻下的守灵门三个字。
怎么山壁变成了光滑的石壁，难道掌门师父想学别的门派，也刻点霸气的字词在大门口，好显得本门厉害？
不过怎么会有这么多人在山门外，守灵派又不是什么名门大派，说难听的就算是有人结元婴，都不会来这么多人祝贺。
她好奇地飞落，站在人群后面想看看他们是什么人，在这里干什么。
就听到人群里响起了叫好声，还有人使劲拍着巴掌，好像一群在村镇街头围观杂耍的凡人。
花乾很确定四周全是修士，半个凡人也没有。修为最高的那些一看就是结丹期，四周除了带来的弟子，大家都自动离他们远些。
炼气和筑基的也不少，虽然站得近，但还是能看得出来，全是一伙伙结伴而来。
这时，一个声音从高处传来，“下一个报来。”
content_en:
Blue Wind Continent, Ningli Prefecture.
The blue sky is as clear as a wash, and the white clouds are like cotton. A streak of colored light passes through, dragging a light and shadow in the sky, and it takes a long time to slowly dissipate.
The flower stem stepped on a peach blossom jade hairpin as big as a washbasin, and the colored light and the phantom of peach blossom petals were scattered behind it, flying towards the sect without stopping.
When she was traveling abroad, she accidentally heard that the Shouling Sect where she belonged had borrowed a large amount of debt from various places twenty years ago to enhance the strength of its disciples.
If you want to win the first place in the Nine Ju Secret Realm Conference thirty years later, the benefits will not only be able to pay off all debts, but also improve the sect's status in the Blue Wind Continent.
Huagan, who had been traveling for twenty-nine years after establishing the foundation, didn't know about this at all. After hearing the news, she hurried back and wanted a piece of the pie.
Although twenty years have passed since this incident, for the monks, this time can only be closed for a while, and the large amount of supplies obtained by the sect cannot be used up at all.
Hua Gan never expected that the head master, who had always been steady and mature and only wanted to slowly improve his strength, could be so determined and borrow so much debt.
It seems that the senior brother has probably advanced to the middle stage of pill formation in the years since he left, which made the leader's confidence greatly increased, and he dared to say that he would compete for the benefits of the Nine Ju Secret Realm.
"I don't know what good things other than the eldest brother, the second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh and eighth other senior brothers have been given. As long as each senior brother and sister give me something, I will be the richest kid in the whole sect." She thought happily.
As the youngest disciple in the Shou Ling Sect, a small sect with only thirty-two disciples, Huagan was deeply loved by the leader.
She also received the love and care of thirty-one senior brothers and sisters. When she left the sect to travel, the senior brothers and sisters donated their money to help her and gave her all the good things they had except the magic weapon.
Let her travel with peace of mind and not have to worry about the sect. If she doesn't return to the sect for hundreds of years, she can come back only after the Dan Yuan Ying is formed.
Don't come back just because you have nothing to do. The monks have aspirations in all directions. It is not good to think about returning to the sect all day long.
If possible, find a talented person from a famous family, marry him directly and become the leader or the wife of an elder. Try your best to pursue your own happiness. Don't worry about everyone in the sect. Everyone just wants her to live well.
Huagan was deeply moved and brought many good things to his brothers and sisters when he returned this time.
There are fruits, pancakes, steamed buns, cat poop candies and other snacks bought in the small village three thousand miles away, as well as sachets, wooden beads, hand-strings, silk-head flowers and other items, which are all things that are not found in the sect.
Although it was not valuable, it was worth it because it was her heart. She felt that her senior brothers and sisters would be extremely moved and pass on the good things the sect received to her.
It would be great if I had a dozen magic weapons for myself.
The flower stems smacked their lips, and spiritual power was injected into Tao Yuchai, flying faster, wishing to return to the sect in an instant.
Eight days later, [cáng] Zangxian Mountain, guarding the spirit gate.
Hurrying slowly, Hua Gan finally saw a familiar sect. He felt excited and flew straight to the mountain gate.
Suddenly, she saw a lot of people gathered around the mountain gate from a distance. There were two to three hundred monks. Everyone gathered in front of a stone wall beside the mountain gate.
"Huh?" Hua Gan was a little strange. If she remembered correctly, there was clearly a mountain guarding stone more than ten feet high beside the mountain gate. On the mountain wall were the words "Shou Lingmen" carved by the founder of the sect.
Why did the mountain wall turn into a smooth stone wall? Could it be that the head master wanted to imitate other sects and carve some domineering words on the gate to make his sect appear powerful?
But why are there so many people outside the mountain gate? The Soul Watching Sect is not a famous sect. It is embarrassing to say that even if someone is married to a Nascent Soul, so many people will not come to congratulate them.
She flew down curiously and stood behind the crowd to see who they were and what they were doing here.
I heard cheers from the crowd, and some people clapped their hands vigorously, as if a group of people were in the village.The mortals gathered on the streets of the town to watch the jugglers.
Huagan was pretty sure that the surroundings were all monks, not even half a mortal. Those with the highest level of cultivation were in the elixir formation stage at first glance. Except for the disciples they brought, everyone around them took the initiative to stay away from them.
There were also quite a few people refining Qi and building foundations. Although they stood close to each other, they could still tell that they all came together in groups.
At this time, a voice came from high up, "The next report is coming."
